test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence:

"The assignment work has been successfully finished ahead of time by Pragna."

options.text: Pragna has finished her assignment work ahead of time.
Pragna has successfully finished her assignment ahead of time.
Pragna have successfully finished her assignment work ahead of time.
Pragna has successfully finished her assignment work ahead of time.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 

• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 

• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Pragna has successfully finished her assignment work ahead of time." 

• To convert to active voice: Ensure the subject "Pragna" performs the action. 

• Ensure the verb "has been successfully finished" is converted to "has successfully finished" (active voice structure). 

• Maintain the time phrase "ahead of time" at the end of the sentence for clarity. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**. 
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Pragna has successfully finished her assignment work ahead of time."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 

• **Option 1: **"Pragna has finished her assignment work ahead of time." – Missing the word "successfully." 

• **Option 2: **"Pragna has successfully finished her assignment ahead of time." – Missing the word "work." 

• **Option 3: **"Pragna have successfully finished her assignment work ahead of time." – Incorrect subject-verb agreement ("have" instead of "has").
